name: claude-forge
description: Collection of handy plugins for Claude Code

plugins.name: ideation
plugins.description: Multi-agent codebase ideation framework. Analyzes projects for improvements across security, UI/UX, performance, code quality, documentation, and code patterns.

plugins.name: git-commands
plugins.description: Git workflow skills: create commits following project rules or Conventional Commits, generate PR descriptions, sync the current branch with its base (rebase when clean, merge otherwise), and clean up gone branches and their worktrees — with safety gates throughout.

plugins.name: gh-commands
plugins.description: GitHub workflow skills via the gh CLI. Opens a pull request end to end — committing and drafting through git-commands, then gh pr create — with preflight, adaptive state detection, and a confirmation gate.
